image_description: A high-angle, close-up shot of a pile of cooked Dungeness crabs resting on crushed ice. The crabs exhibit the characteristic orange-red coloration of cooked crustaceans. Multiple individuals are visible, overlapping in a dense arrangement. Key anatomical features such as the broad oval carapace, walking legs, and claws are present, though significant occlusion occurs due to the piling. The lighting is bright, creating specular highlights on the wet shells and ice.
